sampling_policy.grouping: Connected components sharing NFKC/casefold/whitespace-normalised claim OR reference, ignoring gold label; no group split.
sampling_policy.exclusions: All components touching the historical 60 dev rows or the local v1.5 smoke claim.
sampling_policy.selection: Shuffle eligible row IDs with Random(20261012); sort then separately shuffle the 27 language-pair/label cells with the same seed. For three rounds, choose the first row in each cell whose component has not been selected.
sampling_policy.quota: Three rows per language-pair/label cell; one representative per component; no predictions used.

limitations: Exploratory comparison only: historical full-corpus retrieval experiments already exposed this dataset.
No unseen vote date remains after excluding historical dev vote dates. Not booklet-, vote- or time-disjoint.
Normalised exact matching does not detect every translated or semantic near-duplicate. An independent final evaluation needs new, manually reviewed vote/topic-disjoint data.
Freeze configuration before the run; do not tune on this sample or change gold labels. Context-limit failures stay in the denominator.
